info.shortName: PIMCO Broad U.S. TIPS Index Exc
info.longName: PIMCO Broad U.S. TIPS Index Exchange-Traded Fund

funds_data.description: The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets (exclusive of collateral held from securities lending) in the component securities of the ICE BofA U.S. Inflation-Linked Treasury Index (the "underlying index"). The underlying index is an unmanaged index comprised of Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities ("TIPS").
